sourceClassification.preservation: The unchanged P04 inspection proof classifies both source paths and identifies the exact-byte private archive destination. The composed fixture exercises the API-owned importer with explicit source-user and source-project mappings; unmapped cursor rows remain private and are not exposed by the owner API.

implementedBehavior: The composed synthetic fixture exercises the seven domain migration producers under the eight-module enabled profile over a legacy Git repository and workspace data. It includes both project and workspace SQLite stores, representatives of authoritative and provisional records, notes and scratch assets, user overrides, dictionaries, selected model/settings and usage history, publishing metadata, Story history, and pending/staged local Git work. Secret-like paths and unmapped private rows are checked for exclusion from public proposals and repository Git.

The fixture submits actual producer operations through Core author approval, per-operation checkpointing, and confirmed push to a synthetic bare remote. It removes the complete Core data root, registers a fresh clone, enables modules, reviews and publishes reactivation operations, removes the root again, and verifies exact recovered bytes and stable IDs through another clone. It also checks source-tree immutability and idempotent reinspection.

The R43 fixture starts with exact desktop and mobile source `updatedAt` values, captures the desktop `updatedAt` returned by a newer live owner API PUT, and asserts those exact timestamps after reimport and the second complete Core data-root replacement. Private cursor state is not published to Git; the raw source archive remains exact and owner-cookie protected.
